337	// Stop cancels all running scrape pools and blocks until all have exited.
338	func (m *Manager) Stop() {
339		m.mtxScrape.Lock()
340		defer m.mtxScrape.Unlock()
341	
342		// Stop pools in parallel as each stop() blocks until all its scrape
343		// loops have exited, which can take a long time if there's a lot of
344		// pools with high number of targets.
345		// Limit the number of pools stopping at once to avoid unbounded goroutines.
346		g := new(errgroup.Group)
347		g.SetLimit(runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0))
348		for _, sp := range m.scrapePools {
349			g.Go(func() error {
350				sp.stop()
351				return nil
352			})
353		}
354		_ = g.Wait()
355		close(m.graceShut)
356	}
